channel.title: 1000 Errors: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures
channel.description: Laser Cut Art & Light Sculptures by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Lotus Flower of Life Lamp, Laser Cut Wooden Pendant Light
item.description: Close-up of the lotus lamp's petals with Flower of Life cut-outs. 3D lotus lamp with the Flower of Life pattern in gold, silver or natural wood. Hangs from the ceiling or stands as a table or floor lamp. 38–115cm wide. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Hexstatic LED Light Sculpture, Flower of Life Wood Mandala
item.description: Olly Balsom holding the Hexstatic hexagonal light sculpture glowing pink. Flower of Life inspired mandala in hexagon layers, laser cut from birch, hand painted and lit with adjustable LEDs. 35–70cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Platonic Energy Circle, LED Sacred Geometry Wall Mandala
item.description: Platonic Energy Circle wooden mandala wall sculpture lit in blue. Three-layer laser cut birch wall mandala featuring the five platonic solids, with colour-changing LED lighting. 60cm or 89cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Christmas Ornaments, Laser Cut Birch Set of 10
item.description: Sacred geometry wooden Christmas ornaments hanging from a tree branch outdoors. Ten laser cut and engraved birch Christmas tree ornaments: a 20cm star plus nine 6.5cm sacred geometry pieces. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Quintessence LED Light Sculpture, 5-Layer Wood Mandala
item.description: Quintessence wooden mandala light sculpture glowing red on its stand. Five-fold sacred geometry light sculpture in 5 layers of laser cut wood, with colour-changing LEDs and a stand. Numbered first run. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.

item.title: Seed of Life LED Light Sculpture, Laser Cut Birch Mandala
item.description: Seed of Life light sculpture glowing in rainbow colours on a shop wall. Seed of Life sacred geometry light sculpture, laser cut from layered birch and hand painted, with adjustable LED lighting. 30–80cm. Made in Bristol, UK. Designed and made by 1000 Errors in Bristol, UK.
